assets.name: hero
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide website hero photograph for a Korean youth career exploration community, staged example with entirely fictitious people. Scene: a bright contemporary Korean university neighborhood cafe with large windows, a wood shared table and subtle green plants. Subjects: exactly three ordinary Korean university students or early-career friends in their twenties (two women and one man), candidly collaborating over one notebook and a plain unbranded laptop. Different everyday casual clothing, natural hair, authentic skin textures, understated expressions, one person listening while another explains a note. Composition: landscape 3:2 at high resolution, medium-wide editorial photograph, people grouped toward the middle-right; faces comfortably within the frame with headroom, the left quarter has softly lit cafe context and breathing room. Eye level documentary lens, natural depth. Lighting: gentle daylight, warm ivory walls, realistic color and a subtle green accent from plants only. No direct look to camera, no posed high fives, no exaggerated smiles, no stock photography glamour, no flawless model retouching. No visible logos, no legible text, no captions, no watermark. Natural human anatomy and plausible fingers, realistic material texture. Deliver one coherent photographic image, not collage.
